fact: The September 2025 World Bank mission proposed a joint DGRN and DPSSF campaign in early 2026 to update the Cadastro Social Unico while registering the population on the new digital identity, with a shared database.
title: Ajuda Memoria, Missao de Apoio a Implementacao para o Projecto Digital Sao Tome e Principe, 8 a 12 de setembro de 2025
